title: solutions-pro-services-weekly-sync-notes-2026-04-21
content:
Weekly sync notes: Solutions Engineering + Professional Services — 2026-04-21

Attendees:
- Maya Patel (owner)
- Ethan Brooks
- Sofia Martinez
- Liam Chen
- Nina Gupta
- Guest: Claire Donovan (Customer Success) for Acme Health deep-dive

Agenda:
1) Quick round-robin customer updates (10m)
2) Blockers / escalations (10m)
3) Action items & owners (5m)
4) Infra/ops asks for Dedicated/Private deployments (5m)

Standup-style notes (what I did / will do / blockers)
- Maya P: Completed integration test harness for Acme Health staging environment; will validate end-to-end auth flows on Thurs; blocker = intermittent KV-cache eviction causing trace mismatch (raised SE-423).
- Ethan B: Finished embedding tuning scripts for Vertex Retail; running 48h A/B compare; will prepare perf summary; blocker = dataset sampling rules need sign-off from CS.
- Sofia M: Demo prep for Nimbus Finance scheduled next Mon; completed sandbox provisioning for private deployment; will finalize rollout doc; blocker = compliance checklist item on HSM integration pending security input.
- Liam C: Addressed a batcher timeout in Dedicated pool (patch merged PR #762); will monitor metrics; no blockers.
- Nina G: Followed up with infra on region capacity; will onboard two new dedicated GPU nodes for PROSERV customers; blocker = procurement SLA on hardware arrival.

Customer updates (priority order)
1) Acme Health (high touch, PHI concerns)
- Current status: Integration testing in staging (E2E auth + prompt sets).
- Recent: Completed prefix caching verification, fixed tokenization mismatch in model v1.2.
- Blockers: intermittent KV cache eviction (affects session continuity) -> SE-423 assigned to Maya & Liam.
- Next steps: Maya to run extended session test 2026-04-23; Claire (CS) to run sample clinical prompts and flag quality regressions. Estimated ETA for staging sign-off: 2026-05-04 if no new regressions.

2) Vertex Retail (medium touch)
- Current status: Embedding pipeline tuning + reranker experiments.
- Recent: Ethan completed hyperparam sweep for text-embedding-ada style model; initial results show 6% MAP improvement in reranking A/B.
- Blockers: Data sampling policy needs final approval (privacy redaction rules) -> ACTION: CS to provide final dataset copy by 2026-04-24.
- Next steps: Run production-like inference on Dedicated pool once dataset is cleared; target: 2026-05-01 for pilot.

3) Nimbus Finance (enterprise, private deployment)
- Current status: Private control plane setup in customer VPC; HSM/KMS integration in progress.
- Recent: Sandbox infra provisioned; demo scheduled 2026-04-27.
- Blockers: Security has an open item on HSM integration patterns and audit logging formats. Sofia owning security sync.
- Next steps: Sofia to confirm HSM key rotation policy and provide doc to Nimbus security by 2026-04-24.

Blockers & escalations
- SE-423: KV-cache eviction causing session discontinuities (affects Acme Health). Action: Maya + Liam to triage memory pressure + batching code path; escalate to runtime team if not resolved by 2026-04-24.
- PROSERV-88: Procurement delay for Dedicated GPU nodes; Ops/Procurement to update ETA by 2026-04-23.
- Security: HSM integration checklist outstanding for Nimbus Finance; need security engineering review and sign-off (Sofia to coordinate).

Decisions made
- For time-sensitive customer demos, we will use a dedicated smaller model variant (quantized) to reduce tail latency — accepted for Vertex pilot.
- If KV-cache eviction recurs under load, fallback policy: route active sessions to warm nodes and enable prefix-only caching as temporary mitigation.

Action items (owner / ETA)
- Maya Patel: Run extended E2E session tests for Acme Health (focus on KV cache) — ETA 2026-04-23.
- Liam Chen: Monitor Dedicated pool metrics after batcher timeout patch; collect 48h of traces — ETA 2026-04-23.
- Ethan Brooks: Produce embedding A/B report and prepare pilot run plan for Vertex Retail — ETA 2026-04-28.
- Sofia Martinez: Finalize HSM integration doc and security checklist for Nimbus Finance — ETA 2026-04-24.
- Nina Gupta: Follow up with procurement on GPU node ETA and provide mitigation plan — ETA 2026-04-23.
- Claire Donovan (CS): Run clinical prompt quality set on Acme staging and share failures — ETA 2026-04-24.

Notes / loose ideas
- Consider a short-run canary that uses prefix-only cache for sensitive PHI sessions to reduce KV eviction impact.
- Add a standard troubleshooting playbook entry for KV-cache eviction (to console docs) — owner: Maya.

Next meeting: 2026-04-28 10:00 PT (weekly cadence)

Quick links referenced in meeting:
- SE-423 (ticket)
- PROSERV-88 (procurement)
- Confluence: Acme Health integration runbook (link above)
- PR: infra/pull/762 (batcher timeout fix)

Notes written by: Maya Patel
Status: in_review — ping team for comments before EOD 2026-04-22
